Companion Animal Travel Desk notice for travelers

Travelers must confirm your pet meets Aurelia Skyways handling limits before departure, to keep the journey safe and smooth.

For each animal, we follow a simple safety window. A reptile becomes eligible to travel at 11 weeks, which means it is the youngest age the animal can fly.

Crate fit is the next checkpoint. For a cat, the longest crate side may extend to 61 cm, which means the greatest measurement of one crate edge must not exceed that length.

Please have your pet crate ready for quick inspection and ensure it closes securely without pressure points. Use stable bedding and clear labeling so our handlers can follow care instructions without delay. When more than one traveler is affected, the coordination team will guide you in the proper sequence; travelers Julian Dubois and Nikhil Khan should present Blue for verification at the earliest opportunity.

If any requirement is unclear, stop at the Companion Animal Travel Desk before check-in so we can document the crate and confirm eligibility without upsetting your timetable.

Proceed to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for final clearance.
